description.zh-TW: 多視窗與關閉行為的逐項測試：key 復用、list/post/broadcast、關閉原因，以及 closeOnEsc / closeOnBlur / closeOnOutsideClick / modal、透明與滑鼠穿透、HTML 內容與卡片自操作。
description.zh-CN: 多窗口与关闭行为的逐项测试：key 复用、list/post/broadcast、关闭原因，以及 closeOnEsc / closeOnBlur / closeOnOutsideClick / modal、透明与鼠标穿透、HTML 内容与卡片自操作。
description.en: Checks for several windows: key reuse, list/post/broadcast, close reasons, closeOnEsc / closeOnBlur / closeOnOutsideClick / modal, transparency and click-through, HTML content, and the card's own window calls.
